Barcodes of each gene

Source: R/camera_method.R
unique_gene_symbols.Rd

Internal function that returns, for each gene with more than number_barcode barcodes, the indices of its barcodes.

Usage

unique_gene_symbols(gene_symbols, number_barcode = 3)

Arguments

gene_symbols

The gene of each barcode.

...

Arguments passed on to find_camera_hit

number_barcode

Only genes with more than number_barcode barcodes are tested (default 3, so a gene needs at least 4 barcodes). The barcodes of a gene are tested together as a set, so this is not a number of barcodes that must change.

Value

A named list with the indices of the barcodes of each gene.
